The Customer Service Woman rushes to them, worried about Anna's issue.
Ted reveals he's already aware of and solved Anna's problem.
They attribute their quick resolution to their new system, Genesis.
The Customer Service Woman expresses surprise at the new system and a 'Keep Calm We Have Genesys' sign.

narrativeProgression.description: Ted and the Woman with Braid have already solved Anna's problem thanks to their new Genesys system. The Customer Service Woman seems out of the loop and humorously overreacts.
Ted explains the money transfer has been completed because of Genesys.
The Customer Service Woman is surprised by the new system.
